SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM inquiry WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
